item.title: [−2] Brent climbs to a near two-week high of about $106 on Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
item.description:
A drone hit a tanker near Sohar, Oman, and Houthis can still hit Saudi tankers in the Red Sea. Brent eased to about $105.86 on Tuesday. Reverses Monday morning's dip to $103.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: headwind (−2) — Jet fuel and freight

Why it matters: Attacks on Saudi Arabia threaten India's main non-Hormuz crude supplier and its Red Sea route, keeping the import bill and fuel costs high.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−2] Iran's Guard strikes another supertanker; two ships with 22 Indian crew attacked, two missing
item.description:
Iran warned ships against defying its orders and threatened a US–UAE oil shuttle out of the strait. Sixty countries backed an EU declaration opposing tolls on strait shipping. Escalating.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: headwind (−2) — War-risk insurance and crew pay

Why it matters: Repeated strikes and toll threats keep insurance, freight and crude costs high on India's main energy route, and put Indian crews at risk.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
